facts.fact: 革命以贴纸开场：Pineto 公园 2 月 16 日 23:00 的派对邀请，达·马雷的漫画被当众羞辱。
facts.anchor: Before dawn thousands of stickers are plastered across Rome.

facts.fact: 胡克自陈：掌握 Michele 的血就能终结与彼得·潘的永恒战争，当夜让魔法流亡、角神死。
facts.anchor: he will put an end to the eternal war with Peter Pan.

facts.fact: Michele 推断是 Greta 出卖了 Dagon 的住处，愤怒来自「被骗」而非「被背叛」。
facts.anchor: There was only one person that could have led the pirates to Dagon’s house. “Greta,” Michele says.

facts.fact: Giovanni 当着胡克打弟弟表忠心，"为了 Luisa" 是给 Michele 的暗号：他是卧底。
facts.anchor: “For Luisa,” he says, his voice just barely loud enough for Michele and Uncle Augusto to hear it.

facts.fact: 精灵解释神的诞生机制：千万人的情绪催生神，Giada 不是源头而是"最后一滴"。
facts.anchor: They’re brought forth from the emotions of thousands: gods are born of orgies.

facts.fact: Barrie 以写故事的方式把 Pan 与 Greyface 一起囚禁，等待未来有人解开。
facts.anchor: At that point a mortal mage, James Matthew Barrie, intervened.

facts.fact: Temidorus 讲出真相即破咒：二神因此解禁，潘的囚笼碎裂，决战变成"to the death"。
facts.anchor: You don’t believe in that story any more: you have another. So its spell is broken.

facts.fact: Michele 在 Dream 中以罗马众灵之力击败 Greyface，反用其法把他囚进血肉。
facts.anchor: Now I exile you: by killing you in Dream, I confine you to Flesh, prisoner of blood and of bone.
